PROC
PROC_CAMP_LeftCamp(_Player)
AND
GetEquippedItem(_Player, "Amulet", S_UND_MonkAmulet_Amulet_de2ea5a9-943a-4794-9ef7-208be7747178)
AND
DB_UND_MonkAmulet_IncreaseMadnessThreshold(_Threshold)
AND
DB_GlobalCounter("UND_MonkAmulet_ResistMadnessCounter", _Count)
AND
_Count >= _Threshold
AND
GetFlag(UND_MonkAmulet_State_MajorMadness_cb463ada-23b1-49fb-9fbc-0bfb54520922, _Player, 0)
THEN
ObjectTimerLaunch(_Player, "UND_MonkAmulet_ResistMadnessDialog", 5000);

IF
OnThrown(S_FOR_Courier_Ball_c9602f79-27a8-4f79-b0f2-3aba300bd80f, _, _Player, _, _, _, _)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)CAMP_Courier_Dog_Moved2Camp_7dcb7732-1c76-463a-bec9-251f30860e6c)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag((FLAG)GLO_CourierDog_State_UnavailableForSummon_0fef1fa5-9216-4833-94c1-5fe1da7da7c7)
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD(Scratch_SummonUnavailable_PAD_84aafd7d-0e0c-74d8-7be4-791021a771a4, _Player);

IF
UseFinished(_Player, S_WYR_Jungle_Portal_21b6cd38-39b9-4369-9838-c0e4e5e7acce, 1)
AND
QRY_OnlyOncePerUser(_Player, "WYR_Circus_ReturnFromJungle_OnlyOnce")
THEN
RealtimeObjectTimerLaunch(_Player, "WYR_Circus_ReturnFromJungle_Timer", 1000);

IF
AttackedBy(S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceDoor_ec90dfc0-becb-4918-b003-603d6e7a3ffa, _Player, _, _, _, _, _)
AND
NOT DB_Defeated(S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceGuard_3f27f04f-4041-462e-9db3-a3ba163eb0c6)
AND
DB_GlobalFlag(WYR_WyrmRockPrison_State_EntranceGuardSleeping_fb11ba89-ea58-49c6-b57c-f34a9f81fa0c)
AND
HasAppliedStatus(S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceDoor_ec90dfc0-becb-4918-b003-603d6e7a3ffa, "SILENCED", 0)
AND
HasAppliedStatus(S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceGuard_3f27f04f-4041-462e-9db3-a3ba163eb0c6, "SILENCED", 0)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("WYR_WyrmRockPrison_WakeUpGuardVandalise")
THEN
SetFlag(WYR_WyrmRockPrison_Event_WakeUpEntranceGuard_5495e2e7-8a6e-4d2f-8e67-307062f24e54);
SetFlag((FLAG)WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceGuard_Knows_DoorDestroyed_4d55d25e-7a22-4d19-b23d-99c9ce96cbf1);
DB_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceGuardVandalism((ITEM)S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_EntranceDoor_ec90dfc0-becb-4918-b003-603d6e7a3ffa, _Player);

PROC
PROC_ApplySavegamePatches()
AND
QRY_BG3_SaveGameIsOlderThan(4,0,9,0)
AND
DB_CurrentLevel("INT_Main_A")
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_InRegion(_Player, (TRIGGER)S_CRE_AstralPlaneArea_cc0ba8c0-ae50-4f12-8ea4-7db1ff8e62b0)
THEN
PROC_TriggerUnregisterForParty((TRIGGER)S_CRE_AstralPlaneArea_cc0ba8c0-ae50-4f12-8ea4-7db1ff8e62b0);
PROC_SetOnStage(S_CRE_AstralPrison_GlobeOfDomination_e7901694-5e21-4077-9a7b-b8d36b8b53a8, 0);
DB_BUGFIX_Marker("GUS-300504");
